name: [QRPS] ORSIS T-5000M 'Tochnost' .338 Bolt-Action Rifle
teaser: A Lapua ORSIS? You better believe it - And the attachments work on the regular one as well! An old classic from FancyDream from the old days of AKI 2.0, updated and tweaked for 3.10!
description_html:
A .338 Lapua ORSIS, featuring an upgrade kit that’s usable on the original ORSIS as well! Featuring two longer handguards, a custom .338 supressor that you can use on other .338 rifles, and a very nice top-mounting bipod (that only gives stats, soz lads), this classic mod from FancyDream gets one last hurrah before the Unity update bricks the old bundles.

FAQ:

Where buy? Skier LL3

Realism? Yes

Where original? Oddba

Does bipod work for mounting? Nope, as-is, it’s just a very pretty stat-stick like ye olde bipods, but hey ho, it’s a top-mounting bipod, you take what you can get.

Why can I put the bipod upside down? I made the bipod work like a tactical device in case you want to use it on other guns. Unfortunately this means you *can* technically mount it upside down. If you want to run it upside down, you can I guess. It’d be a chunk of work to make it only work on the top slots of handguards so I kinda took a lazy approach.

What QRPS? Qwerty-Reaper Porting Service (Turns out there’s a bunch of old bundles on Oddba that never got updated, and we decided to port some of them to give them one last hurrah before the Unity update bricks the bundles, also I like acronyms.)

Credits to the original author FancyDream! We wouldn’t have this now if you didn’t originally make these awesome bundles!
